description: All-in-one governed ops suite: 16 Stripe payment commands (refunds, disputes, subscriptions, invoices, PaymentIntents), 10 Twilio SMS/voice commands, and 3 cross-provider billing-reminder commands that look up a real Stripe invoice and text its amount and due date via Twilio -- one signed bundle, every write gated by RailCall's preview -> approve -> execute airlock. contest:2026Q3

commands.name: list_charges
commands.title: List Charges
commands.description: List recent charges, optionally filtered by customer.

customer_id.description: Stripe customer ID (cus_...) to filter by. Optional.

commands.name: get_customer
commands.title: Get Customer
commands.description: Fetch a single customer's profile and balance.

commands.name: search_customers
commands.title: Search Customers
commands.description: Find customers by name or email when you don't have their cus_ ID. This is how you turn a person's name (e.g. 'Riley Novak') into their customer ID before looking up their charges or invoices. Returns matching customers with their id, name, and email.

commands.name: get_payment_intent
commands.title: Get Payment Intent
commands.description: Fetch one PaymentIntent by ID: its status, amount, capture state, and the underlying charge. Use this to verify a pi_... someone gives you (e.g. copied from the Stripe dashboard) before refunding or canceling it.

commands.name: list_disputes
commands.title: List Disputes
commands.description: List open and recent disputes/chargebacks.

commands.name: create_refund
commands.title: Create Refund
commands.description: Refund a charge or payment intent, in full or in part. Money-moving: gated by the airlock.

charge_id.description: Charge ID (ch_...). Provide this OR payment_intent_id.

payment_intent_id.description: PaymentIntent ID (pi_...). Provide this OR charge_id.

amount_cents.description: Partial refund amount in cents. Omit for a full refund.

commands.name: respond_to_dispute
commands.title: Respond to Dispute
commands.description: Submit evidence on a dispute. Money-relevant (affects dispute outcome): gated by the airlock.

evidence_text.description: Uncategorized evidence text explaining the transaction.

submit.description: If true, submit immediately. If false, save evidence as a draft without submitting.

commands.name: cancel_subscription
commands.title: Cancel Subscription
commands.description: Cancel a customer's subscription, immediately or at period end. Revenue-affecting: gated by the airlock.

at_period_end.description: If true, cancel at the end of the current billing period instead of immediately.

commands.name: capture_payment_intent
commands.title: Capture Payment Intent
commands.description: Capture a previously authorized (uncaptured) payment, in full or in part. Money-moving: gated by the airlock.

amount_to_capture_cents.description: Partial capture amount in cents. Omit to capture the full authorized amount.

commands.name: cancel_payment_intent
commands.title: Cancel Payment Intent
commands.description: Cancel an uncaptured PaymentIntent, releasing its authorization so it can never be captured. Use this instead of a refund for a charge that hasn't been captured yet -- Stripe rejects refunds on uncaptured charges. Money-relevant: gated by the airlock.

cancellation_reason.description: One of: duplicate, fraudulent, requested_by_customer, abandoned.

commands.name: void_invoice
commands.title: Void Invoice
commands.description: Void a draft or open invoice so it can no longer be paid or collected. Money-relevant: gated by the airlock.

commands.name: search_charges
commands.title: Search Charges
commands.description: Filtered charge search (amount range, status, customer, date window) using Stripe's Search Query Language -- not just a plain list.

min_amount_cents.description: Only charges >= this amount, in cents.

max_amount_cents.description: Only charges <= this amount, in cents.

customer_id.description: Stripe customer ID (cus_...) to filter by.

created_after.description: Unix timestamp; only charges created after this.

created_before.description: Unix timestamp; only charges created before this.

commands.name: customer_360
commands.title: Customer 360
commands.description: One-call customer overview: profile + recent charges + subscriptions, joined together. Saves 3 separate lookups.

commands.name: list_disputes_due_soon
commands.title: Disputes Due Soon
commands.description: Disputes filtered and sorted by urgency -- only ones whose evidence deadline is within N days, soonest first.

within_days.description: Deadline window in days. Defaults to 7.

commands.name: bulk_refund
commands.title: Bulk Refund
commands.description: Refund up to 25 charges in one airlock-approved action. Money-moving: gated by the airlock.

charge_ids.description: List of charge IDs (ch_...) to refund, up to 25.

reason.description: One of: duplicate, fraudulent, requested_by_customer. Applied to every refund in the batch.

commands.name: cancel_subscription_and_refund
commands.title: Cancel Subscription & Refund
commands.description: Multi-step: cancels a subscription AND refunds its latest invoice's charge in one airlock-approved action. Money-moving: gated by the airlock.

at_period_end.description: If true, cancel at period end instead of immediately. Defaults to false (immediate).

also_refund_latest_invoice.description: If false, only cancels (no refund). Defaults to true.

commands.name: list_messages
commands.title: List Messages
commands.description: List recent sent/received SMS messages, optionally filtered by to/from number.

to.description: Filter by recipient phone number (E.164, e.g. +15551234567).

commands.name: get_message
commands.title: Get Message
commands.description: Fetch one message's full status and details by SID.

commands.name: search_messages
commands.title: Search Messages
commands.description: Filtered message search: to/from number, date range, and status -- not just a plain list.

date_sent_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD; only messages sent after this date.

date_sent_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD; only messages sent before this date.

status.description: One of: queued, sending, sent, failed, delivered, undelivered, receiving, received.

commands.name: list_calls
commands.title: List Calls
commands.description: List recent voice calls, optionally filtered by recipient.

commands.name: account_usage
commands.title: Account Usage
commands.description: One-call overview: account balance + this month's usage records, joined together.

commands.name: send_sms
commands.title: Send SMS
commands.description: Send one SMS message. Money-moving and compliance-relevant: gated by the airlock.

to.description: Recipient phone number (E.164, e.g. +15551234567). Must be a verified caller ID on trial accounts.

from.description: Your Twilio phone number to send from.

body.description: The exact message text to send.

commands.name: make_call
commands.title: Make Call
commands.description: Place one voice call that reads a short message aloud. Money-moving: gated by the airlock.

to.description: Recipient phone number. Must be a verified caller ID on trial accounts.

from.description: Your Twilio phone number to call from.

say_text.description: The exact text that will be read aloud on the call.

commands.name: bulk_send_sms
commands.title: Bulk Send SMS
commands.description: Send the same message to up to 25 recipients in one airlock-approved action. Money-moving: gated by the airlock.

to_numbers.description: List of recipient phone numbers, up to 25.

from.description: Your Twilio phone number to send from.

body.description: The exact message text sent to every recipient in the batch.

commands.name: draft_and_send_sms
commands.title: Draft & Send SMS
commands.description: Renders a template + variables into the exact final message text, shows that literal text for review, then sends. The airlock preview shows the real words, not just 'a message will be sent'. Money-moving: gated by the airlock.

to.description: Recipient phone number. Must be a verified caller ID on trial accounts.

from.description: Your Twilio phone number to send from.

template.description: Message template using {{variable}} placeholders, e.g. 'Hi {{name}}, your order {{order_id}} shipped!'

variables.description: Object of {name: value} pairs to fill into the template.

commands.name: release_phone_number
commands.title: Release Phone Number
commands.description: Deprovisions an owned Twilio number so it can never be used again. Irreversible: gated by the airlock.

phone_number_sid.description: The phone number's SID (PN...), not the number itself.

commands.name: list_invoices_needing_reminder
commands.title: Invoices Needing Reminder
commands.description: List open (unpaid, finalized) Stripe invoices that are due within N days or already overdue, most-overdue first. This is also the way to enumerate unpaid invoices for ANY analysis -- e.g. which customer owes the most, total outstanding, who's overdue -- by passing a large within_days (like 3650) to capture everything open. Each row includes customer_id, customer_name, amount_due (in cents), and due_date. Invoices with no due date are excluded.

within_days.description: Include invoices due within this many days from now. Already-overdue invoices are always included regardless of this value. Defaults to 7.

commands.name: preview_invoice_reminder
commands.title: Preview Invoice Reminder
commands.description: Fetch one Stripe invoice and render the exact SMS text send_invoice_reminder_sms would send -- the real amount, due date, and payment link, in the literal wording. Sends nothing. RailCall's own airlock preview only echoes back your typed inputs, not fetched data, so this command exists to let you actually see the message before you approve sending it.

to.description: The phone number this would be sent to (E.164). Included in the preview output only -- nothing is sent by this command.

custom_note.description: Extra sentence appended to the reminder text.

commands.name: send_invoice_reminder_sms
commands.title: Send Invoice Reminder SMS
commands.description: Composite, two providers, one approval: looks up the real Stripe invoice (amount due, due date, hosted payment link), renders the reminder text, and sends it via Twilio SMS. Run preview_invoice_reminder first to see the exact words this will send. Money-relevant and compliance-relevant: gated by the airlock.

to.description: Recipient phone number (E.164). Must be a verified caller ID on trial Twilio accounts.

from.description: Your Twilio phone number to send from.

custom_note.description: Extra sentence appended to the reminder text.
